title: ACMG/AMP + ClinGen GDV Evidence Field Catalog
description: Complete catalog of 166 evidence fields across 11 categories (A-K) covering ACMG/AMP 2015 variant interpretation criteria, ClinGen SVI 2019 PS3/BS3 refinements (OddsPath framework), ClinGen GDV SOP v12 gene-disease validity curation, and GDV-12 single-paper extractable fields. 143 literature-extractable (A-J) + 23 cross-paper GDV curation fields (K).

high_signal.description: Variant, case, population, prediction, and authority fields

supporting.description: Segregation, functional, case-control, contradiction, and gene function fields

curation.description: Gene-disease validity curation fields - cross-paper, GDV SOP v12

source_references.ACMG_AMP_2015: Richards et al., Genetics in Medicine (2015) - 28 standard variant interpretation criteria
source_references.ClinGen_SVI_2019: Brnich et al., Genome Medicine (2020) - PS3/BS3 OddsPath framework
source_references.ClinGen_GDV_v12: ClinGen Gene Curation SOP v12 - Gene-Disease Validity Curation

items.description: De novo without full parentage confirmation (PM6: assumed de novo, but without confirmation of paternity and maternity)

Quality of both experimental controls (wild-type/null demonstrating assay dynamic range) and clinical validation controls (known pathogenic/benign variants with independent classifications). SVI distinguishes these two types; experimental controls demonstrate dynamic range while validation controls determine OddsPath (ACMG 2019 SVI)
Calculated OddsPath from functional assay validation (ACMG 2019 SVI Table 3)

PS3_supporting (OddsPath >2.1) / PS3_moderate (>4.3) / PS3 (>18.7) / PS3_very_strong (>350) / BS3_supporting (<0.48) / BS3_moderate (<0.23) / BS3_strong (<0.053). Note: BS3_strong is the SVI strong-level equivalent, distinct from the generic ACMG BS3 code (ACMG 2019 SVI Table 3)
Patient-derived material vs model organism vs in vitro cellular system (ACMG 2019 SVI Rec 1-2)
Loss-of-function / gain-of-function / dominant-negative. Prerequisite for Step 1 consistency check; F.disease_mechanism_consistency compares assay against this (ACMG 2019 SVI Step 1 Table 2)

items.field_name: Molecular consequence of variant on assay
items.description: NMD-escaped / splicing impact / protein truncation / missense in assay context (ACMG 2019 SVI Rec 3)
Whether assay models LoF / GoF / dominant-negative consistent with known disease mechanism (ACMG 2019 SVI Step 1)

Three qualifying paths per SVI Step 3 Fig 2: (a) supporting: controls + replicates but <=10 validation controls or historically accepted assay; (b) moderate: >=11 validation controls (mix of benign/pathogenic) without formal OddsPath; (c) formal OddsPath calculated at any strength tier (ACMG 2019 SVI Step 3)
Total classified variant controls for validation; must include a mix of benign AND pathogenic variants; >=11 total required for moderate-level evidence (ACMG 2019 SVI Step 3)
Whether assay performed in CLIA laboratory or with commercially available kit (ACMG 2019 SVI Rec 5)
Score / Contradicts / Review status per GDV-12 p39
Whether cases and controls analyzed using methods with equivalent analytical performance (GDV-12 p39)
Selection bias, demographic matching, genetic ancestry control (GDV-12 p39)
MAF too high / non-significant CC / non-replicated / non-segregation / non-supporting functional (GDV-12 p46)
Disputed vs Refuted severity assessment (GDV-12 p5-8)
